nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the channel inbound/outbound processors and hydrates the binding cache from SQLite, plus the Tauri commands the frontend uses to toggle a channel on/off and change the default channel-launch model.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the channel inbound handler: routes external channel messages to the OS singleton-per-chat session, re-exporting the lifecycle Tauri commands and their generated __cmd__ siblings.
nodes.languageNotes: Doc comment records an Apr-2026 design pivot away from a pure LLM router to a conversation-first OS agent that delegates coding work via a unified subagent tool.

nodes.name: slash.rs
nodes.summary: Handles explicit gateway slash commands (/help, /new, /status, /model, /compact) for channel-bound chats, including model-alias resolution against the account's available models.

nodes.name: desktop.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands and config model for desktop automation safety settings (hide-before-action, anti-detection, escape-abort) plus native macOS Accessibility/ScreenCaptureKit permission checking and request flows.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module declaring the agent Tauri command submodules (automation, channel_handler, desktop, routines, session, tools) and flat-re-exporting routines and session commands for `generate_handler!` resolution.

nodes.name: routines.rs
nodes.summary: Direct-run commands for scheduled/manual routine firing: resolves a pending fire, creates or updates the associated project work item, converts the routine into an orchestrator launch request, and emits routine-changed events to the frontend.

nodes.name: channel.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands for channel-bound agent messaging: routes a user-submitted channel message into the session runtime with attached repo/branch/image context, probes channel credentials, and relays IDE action-bridge results.

nodes.name: coding.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands for the coding-session lifecycle: workspace file listing, snapshot creation/listing/restore, per-file and whole-session revert, todo retrieval, mode listing, and file-review resolution tracking.

nodes.name: ensure_gateway_infra
nodes.summary: Starts the channel inbound/outbound processors and hydrates the channel-binding cache from SQLite; idempotent no-op if already running.

nodes.name: restore_enabled_channels
nodes.summary: Restores previously enabled channel bindings from persistence on app startup.

nodes.name: agent_toggle_channel
nodes.summary: Tauri command that enables or disables a channel integration for an account.

nodes.name: init_channel_session
nodes.summary: Initializes a new channel-bound session with the given account and optional model override.

nodes.name: agent_set_gateway_model
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the default model used for new channel-launched sessions on an account.

nodes.name: handle_command
nodes.summary: Dispatches a parsed gateway slash command (/help, /new, /status, /model, /compact) to its handler and writes an acknowledgment to the outbound bus.

nodes.name: handle_model_command
nodes.summary: Handles /model: resolves the requested model alias against the account's available models and updates the session/channel binding.

nodes.name: resolve_model_target
nodes.summary: Resolves a user-supplied model alias string to a canonical model id for the given account.

nodes.name: best_candidate_for_alias
nodes.summary: Picks the best-matching model candidate for an alias from a list, preferring exact canonical-target matches.

nodes.name: normalize_model_key
nodes.summary: Normalizes a model identifier string (case/whitespace) for alias comparison.

nodes.name: build_help_text
nodes.summary: Builds the static help text listing available slash commands.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Default DesktopConfig: safety features enabled, standard human-input timing.

nodes.name: load_desktop_config_from
nodes.summary: Parses a DesktopConfig from a specific file path, returning defaults if the file is absent or invalid.

nodes.name: save_desktop_config
nodes.summary: Persists a DesktopConfig to its well-known JSON config path.

nodes.name: agent_set_desktop_config
nodes.summary: Tauri command that validates and persists an updated DesktopConfig.

nodes.name: as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the wire string identifier for a DesktopPermissionName variant.

nodes.name: from_wire
nodes.summary: Parses a DesktopPermissionName from its wire string identifier.

nodes.name: grant_instructions
nodes.summary: Returns the OS-specific user instructions for granting a given desktop permission.

nodes.name: permission_status_json
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON status object reported to the frontend for a single permission (name + granted flag).

nodes.name: agent_check_desktop_permissions
nodes.summary: Tauri command that checks the current grant status of Accessibility and ScreenRecording permissions on macOS.

nodes.name: agent_request_desktop_permissions
nodes.summary: Tauri command that triggers the native OS prompt to request a specific desktop automation permission.

nodes.name: DesktopConfig
nodes.summary: Desktop automation safety configuration: whether to hide the app before acting, anti-detection mode, human-input timing profile, and escape-key abort.

nodes.name: DesktopPermissionName
nodes.summary: Enum of native macOS permissions (Accessibility, ScreenRecording) the desktop automation feature depends on.

nodes.name: project_fire_routine
nodes.summary: Tauri command that manually fires a project routine by id, delegating to the internal fire pipeline.

nodes.name: fire_routine_internal
nodes.summary: Resolves an idempotency-guarded pending fire record for a routine and executes it.

nodes.name: execute_pending_fire
nodes.summary: Executes a pending routine fire: creates or updates the associated work item and launches the routine's agent session directly.

nodes.name: fire_status_str
nodes.summary: Maps a routine fire outcome enum to its persisted/display status string.

nodes.name: emit_routine_changed
nodes.summary: Emits a routine-changed event to the frontend with the fire id and resulting status.

nodes.name: launch_routine_direct_session
nodes.summary: Launches a direct (non-orchestrator) agent session for a routine's pending fire.

nodes.name: create_work_item_from_routine
nodes.summary: Creates a new project work item populated from a routine definition and its pending fire, wiring in agent assignment and provenance.

nodes.name: update_existing_work_item_from_routine
nodes.summary: Updates an existing project work item's fields to reflect a re-fired routine's latest configuration.

nodes.name: routine_to_orchestrator_config
nodes.summary: Converts a routine definition into the orchestrator launch configuration shape.

nodes.name: routine_workspace_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk workspace path a routine should run against.

nodes.name: routine_to_launch_request
nodes.summary: Builds the full AgentRunLaunchRequest for firing a routine, including provenance and resource selection.

nodes.name: channel_process_message
nodes.summary: Tauri command that routes a user-submitted channel message (with optional repo/branch/image context) into the session runtime for processing.

nodes.name: agent_probe_channel
nodes.summary: Tauri command that validates a channel's credentials without fully enabling it.

nodes.name: agent_ade_action_result
nodes.summary: Tauri command that relays an IDE (ADE) action-bridge result back into the correlating session.

nodes.name: invalidate_cli_resume_state_best_effort
nodes.summary: Best-effort invalidation of a session's CLI resume state after a mutating operation, logging but not failing on error.

nodes.name: agent_get_session_files
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing the workspace files touched or tracked by a coding session.

nodes.name: agent_get_snapshots
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing the file snapshots recorded for a coding session.

nodes.name: agent_revert
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reverts a session's workspace to its state at a given timestamp, restoring snapshot content across affected files.

nodes.name: agent_restore_snapshot
nodes.summary: Tauri command that restores a specific named snapshot for a session.

nodes.name: agent_revert_file_review
nodes.summary: Tauri command that computes a review diff for reverting a single file to its pre-session snapshot state.

nodes.name: agent_revert_file
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reverts a single file to a specific snapshot hash.

nodes.name: agent_get_todos
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the session's current todo list.

nodes.name: agent_list_modes
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing the available agent operating modes.

nodes.name: agent_resolve_review
nodes.summary: Tauri command marking a session's file review as resolved.

nodes.name: agent_save_file_resolution
nodes.summary: Tauri command persisting a per-file review resolution decision for a session.

nodes.name: agent_get_file_resolutions
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning all saved per-file review resolutions for a session.
